dct_title_s: An exact prospect of Charlestown, the metropolis of the province of South Carolina : printed from a copy of the original engraving, presented to the City Council of Charleston, S.C., by T. Bailey Myers, Esq., of New York, 1882
dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.

Shows a view of Charleston, South Carolina, noting the (A) Granville Bastion, (B) Court House, (C) Council Chamber, (D) Meeting House, (E) St. Phillip's, (F) Custom House, (G) Secretary's Office, (H) Craven's Bastion.
This print of an engraving was included in the Year Book--1882, City of Charleston, S.C. The engraving originally appeared in the London Magazine, June, 1762.
